transcript.speaker: Leo Williams
transcript.content: Hi Amara — it’s Leo Williams, we met at the community event. I’m frustrated because a miscommunication last time meant my device wasn’t repaired as expected; can you tell me what went wrong and confirm when it will be fixed? I rely on it for work, so I need assurance it will be resolved today or get a clear timeline.
